cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Core words: Give and Take.

words.en: Lily gives a card to Grandma.
words.scene: Lily handing a handmade birthday card to smiling Grandma in the living room.
more: Please give me that book, Tom.
Tom，请把书给我。
Dad gives Max a toy.
爸爸给 Max 一个玩具。

words.en: I give the pen back to Sam.
words.scene: Lily holding out a blue pen to return it to her cousin Sam, who is reaching for it.
more: Please give back my book when you finish.
你看完后请把我的书还给我。
Tom gives the cookie back to Mum.
Tom 把饼干还给妈妈。

words.scene: Mum holding an umbrella out to Lily near the front door, rain visible outside.
more: Dad takes a photo of Max.
爸爸给 Max 拍照。
I take my bag to school.
我带书包去学校。

words.scene: Little Tom pulling off a red winter coat in the hallway, looking happy.
more: Please take off your shoes.
请脱鞋。
The plane takes off at noon.
飞机中午起飞。

words.en: Dad picks up Lily from school.
words.scene: Dad standing by a car waving at Lily who is running out of the school gate with her bag.
more: Pick up your ball, Tom!
Tom，捡起你的球！
Mum picks up the phone.
妈妈接电话。

words.scene: Dad patting his pockets looking for a set of keys on the kitchen table.
more: We play to win, not to lose.
我们玩是为了赢，不是为了输。
Tom loses his hat in the wind.
Tom 的帽子被风吹丢了。

words.en: Max looks lost in the park.
words.sz: Max 在公园里看起来迷路了。
words.scene: The puppy Max standing alone on a path in a big green park, looking around with wide eyes.
more: I found my lost ball.
我找到了丢失的球。
Lily feels lost without her map.
没有地图，Lily 感到迷路了。

words.scene: Lily holding up a pair of bright red socks, smiling widely in her bedroom.
more: Tom finds a ball on the street.
Tom 在街上找到一个球。
Can you find the cat?
你能找到猫吗？
How did you find out?
你怎么发现的？
Let's find out who ate the cake.
我们来看看是谁吃了蛋糕。
Keep this box for me, please.
请帮我保存这个盒子。
Grandma keeps old photos in a box.
奶奶把旧照片保存在盒子里。

words.en: Mum sends a letter to Aunt Kate.
words.sz: 妈妈给 Aunt Kate 寄信。
words.scene: Mum putting a stamped envelope into the red postbox on the street corner.
more: I send an email to Sam.
我给 Sam 发电子邮件。
Grandma sends us a photo.
奶奶给我们寄来一张照片。

words.en: Lily receives a gift from Grandpa.
words.sz: Lily 收到了 Grandpa 的礼物。
words.scene: Lily holding a wrapped present with a bow, looking surprised and happy at the front door.
more: We receive post every morning.
我们每天早上收到信件。
Did you receive my message?
你收到我的消息了吗？

words.en: The shop delivers our new bed today.
words.sz: 商店今天把我们的新床送来。
words.scene: Two delivery men carrying a new bed in through the front door, Lily and Tom watching excitedly.
more: We deliver food to Grandma.
我们给奶奶送食物。
They deliver flowers on Monday.
他们星期一送花。

words.en: A bird tries to steal Tom's sandwich.
words.sz: 一只鸟想偷 Tom 的三明治。
words.scene: A cheeky monkey at the zoo stealing a banana from Tom's hand, Tom and Lily laughing.
more: The monkey tried to steal Tom's banana.
猴子试图偷走 Tom 的香蕉。
It is wrong to steal things.
偷东西是不对的。

words.scene: Lily asking Mia for a ruler during maths class, both sitting at school desks.
more: I borrowed a book from the library.
我从图书馆借了一本书。
Max wants to borrow Dad's ball.
Max 想借爸爸的球。

words.sz: 请把你的自行车借给我。
words.scene: Sam holding the handlebars of a blue bike, handing it to Lily in the park.
more: Mum lends Dad her car keys.
妈妈把车钥匙借给爸爸。
Can you lend me a pen?
你能借我一支笔吗？

words.en: Lily shares her cake with Tom.
words.sz: Lily 和 Tom 分享她的蛋糕。
words.scene: Lily holding a plate of chocolate cake slices, offering one to Tom who is smiling happily at the kitchen table.
more: We share toys at school.
我们在学校分享玩具。
Tom shares his apple with Max.
Tom 把他的苹果分给 Max。

words.scene: Grandma standing behind a small wooden table at an outdoor market, with a basket of brown eggs in front of her.
more: The shop sells blue umbrellas.
这家店卖蓝色的雨伞。
We sell old books at school.
我们在学校卖旧书。

words.en: Lily saves money in a box.
words.scene: Lily putting coins into the slot of a pink pig-shaped bank on her desk, coins scattered nearby.
more: I want to save for a new bike.
我想存钱买一辆新自行车。
Tom saves his pocket money every week.
Tom 每周都存零花钱。

words.en: Mum offers me a cup of tea.
words.scene: Mum holding out a white mug of tea towards Lily, who is sitting on the sofa reading.
more: Can I offer you a cookie?
请你吃块饼干好吗？
He offers his seat to Grandma.
他把座位让给奶奶。

words.scene: Dad sitting at a restaurant table pointing at the menu while a waiter writes on a notepad.
more: We order pizza for dinner.
我们点披萨当晚餐。
Mum orders new shoes online.
妈妈在网上订购新鞋。

words.scene: Grandma putting an envelope with a stamp into a red British postbox on the street.
more: Lily posts a card to Sam.
Lily 给 Sam 寄了一张卡片。
I post a card to Grandma every year.
我每年都给奶奶寄一张卡片。

words.scene: Lily standing at the front door holding a pile of envelopes and a small parcel that just came through the letterbox, Max sniffing the parcel.
more: The mail comes at ten o'clock.
邮件十点钟送来。
There is no mail today.
今天没有邮件。

words.scene: Tom holding out a wrapped box with a red bow towards Lily, who looks surprised and happy.
more: Mum bought a nice gift for Dad.
妈妈给爸爸买了一份很好的礼物。
Open your birthday gift, please.
请打开你的生日礼物。

words.scene: Lily hugging a large box wrapped in blue paper with a yellow ribbon, sitting on the living room rug.
more: Grandpa gave me a present.
爷爷给了我一份礼物。
She opened her birthday presents.
她打开了她的生日礼物。
